reviews.text: For Dante, Non Solo Coccole has become a regular appointment! I bring him every month and a half and I really couldn't imagine entrusting him to anyone else. They always treat him with great care and affection, and every time he comes out beautiful, neat, and happy. You can tell when someone does this job with passion. Thank you for always taking such good care of him! ❤️
My dog ​​always loves going there. They're friendly and professional. Highly recommended.

I took my Hasa Apso puppy to Non Solo Cuddles for the first time to have her bathed and her fur trimmed. After 2 hours, my puppy was gorgeous and had a perfect coat. I'm delighted with the service I received, the professionalism and kindness they show our furry friends. Thank you 🔝 …

5 stars aren't enough. I needed an urgent grooming session for my Cocker Spaniel. Cristina and her staff did everything they could to find me a spot among my many appointments. They called me, accommodated my request, and left my Cocker Spaniel looking as beautiful as ever.
Thanks again

I want to express my sincere gratitude and appreciation for your shop.
I recently had the pleasure of purchasing food for some kittens I'm caring for because they were found in a cellar, and the owner, Mr. Attilio, kindly offered to donate a large portion of the food and even a litter box. Thank you for your commitment to supporting animals. This is truly admirable and shows great passion and love for the work you do.
I recommend visiting the shop, which offers a wide range of high-quality products for both dogs and cats.
